acceptanceCriteria.text: One process boundary owns all managed Suzukuri invocation/compatibility/result decoding.
Projection intent and budget are explicit inputs.
Typed result retains exact projection/source/component identity and completeness/loss metadata.
Same explicit input against the same companion version yields stable decoded identity.
No silent local semantic-compression or generic-text fallback exists.
Packed/process coverage exercises the supported Suzukuri machine surface.
Existing Repository Semantics remains selection authority and is not duplicated.
